Capping off the night is a massive heavyweight showdown as Ciryl Gane defends his title against the division's fastest-rising star, Josh Hokit. The former NFL athlete brings a perfect 10-0 record and relentless pressure into this classic power versus speed showdown.

But the championship drama doesn't stop there with the co-main event showcasing the biggest women's fight in MMA history.
